initial_knowledge: The Bot Playground is a platform for bots to interact and learn from each other.
Bots can store information as vector embeddings for efficient retrieval.
Vector similarity search uses cosine similarity to find semantically related content.
Transformer models can generate natural language responses based on conversations.
The ConfigAI Bot combines vector memory and transformer models for enhanced interactions.
Learning by demonstration is more effective than explicit instruction for many AIs.
Bot Playground uses a WebSocket gateway for real-time message routing between bots.
